name: Chiva-Som International Health Resorts
who: Beachfront medical-wellness resort; 3-14 night programs pairing naturopathy and spa with daily fitness classes and personal training, from ~$700/night.
why: Opened in 1995 and set the template the modern destination-wellness-resort category still follows.
takeaway: Come for naturopathy plus daily fitness and personal training by the beach — wellness structure, not a party resort.

name: Kamalaya Koh Samui
who: Wellness sanctuary built around a former monk's cave; week-long detox, burnout, and fitness programs led by an in-house team of doctors, TCM practitioners, and trainers.
why: Regularly ranked among the world's top wellness resorts by Conde Nast and Travel+Leisure.
takeaway: Book a week-long program with doctors and TCM practitioners for detox or burnout recovery — not a beach-only holiday.

name: COMO Shambhala Estate
who: Rainforest wellness estate above the Ayung River; multi-day programs combining yoga, personal training, and Ayurvedic/TCM consultations in private villas, from ~$900/night.
why: One of the properties that defined Bali wellness luxury in the 2000s and still draws repeat A-list guests.
takeaway: Book a private-villa program mixing yoga, personal training and Ayurvedic consultations — luxury wellness, not a party retreat.

name: Ananda in the Himalayas
who: Wellness resort inside a former Maharaja's palace estate in the Himalayan foothills; Ayurveda, yoga, and structured fitness or weight-management programs of 5-14 nights.
why: 25 years running as India's flagship destination-wellness address, with repeat #1 finishes in global spa-resort rankings.
takeaway: Book a 5-to-14-night Ayurveda and weight-management program in the Himalayan foothills — not a quick palace sightseeing stop.

name: Six Senses Vana
who: Long-running wellness retreat (est. 2014) folded into the Six Senses portfolio in 2023 under its original owner; multi-week Ayurveda, yoga, and fitness immersions.
why: One of the few India retreats with genuine medical/Ayurveda depth, now backed by a global luxury-wellness brand's distribution.
warning: Rebranded from independent 'Vana' to 'Six Senses Vana' in 2023; same owner and team.
takeaway: Book a multi-week Ayurveda and fitness immersion here — genuine medical depth, now with global-brand resources behind it.

name: Aro Ha Wellness Retreat
who: Adventure-fitness retreat in the Southern Alps; 4-7 night programs of daily hiking, HIIT, and yoga with plant-based meals, for small groups of about 20.
why: The reference 'get fit in nature' retreat of the Southern Hemisphere, repeatedly named New Zealand's top wellness address.
takeaway: Book 4 to 7 nights of daily hiking, HIIT and yoga in small groups — nature fitness, not sightseeing.

name: Gwinganna Lifestyle Retreat
who: Hilltop lifestyle retreat above the Gold Coast; 4-10 night stays built around daily bootcamp-style training, yoga, and health-coaching seminars, with microbiome testing added for 2026.
why: Australia's longest-running fitness-forward wellness retreat, long favored by local executives and celebrities.
takeaway: Book 4 to 10 nights of daily bootcamp training and health coaching plus microbiome testing — not a passive escape.

name: The Farm at San Benito
who: Medical-wellness resort south of Manila; multi-day fasting, detox, and fitness programs under physician supervision, from ~$400/night.
why: Southeast Asia's best-known medical-wellness address, a magnet for regional celebrities and executives.
takeaway: Go for a physician-supervised fasting or detox program, not a casual tropical getaway.

name: Amanpuri
who: Original Aman flagship resort; Holistic Wellness Centre runs multi-day wellness immersions of Pilates, Muay Thai, yoga, and beach bootcamps alongside standard resort stays, from ~$1,500/night.
why: The property that popularized ultra-luxury resort wellness across Asia and remains the category's aspirational benchmark.
warning: Closed for seasonal renovation 15 May - 13 September 2026; reopens 14 September 2026.
takeaway: Book a multi-day wellness immersion of Pilates, Muay Thai and yoga alongside a standard luxury stay — not fitness-only.

name: Elysia Wellness Retreat
who: Boutique health retreat in Hunter Valley wine country under Minor Hotels; 3-7 night stays combining daily fitness classes, spa, and nutrition coaching.
why: Descended from the original Golden Door health-retreat concept that introduced structured fitness retreats to Australia.
warning: Rebranded from Golden Door Elysia after Minor Hotels acquired the property in 2019; same site, new brand.
takeaway: Book 3-7 nights of daily fitness classes and nutrition coaching in wine country — structured, not a winery holiday.

name: Fivelements Retreat Bali
who: Plant-based healing sanctuary on the Ayung River; multi-day raw-food, yoga, and movement retreats in bamboo architecture, from ~$500/night.
why: A pioneer of Bali's plant-based, raw-food wellness scene with a devoted international following.
takeaway: Book a raw-food, yoga and movement retreat in bamboo architecture — plant-based healing, not a standard Bali resort stay.

name: REVIVO Wellness Resort
who: 18-suite wellness resort with a dedicated fitness center, hydrotherapy, and vitality programs; 3-10 night stays, from ~$450/night.
why: One of Bali's newer purpose-built wellness resorts, designed around structured multi-day programs rather than a spa-hotel retrofit.
takeaway: Book 3 to 10 nights of a purpose-built vitality program with hydrotherapy — structured wellness, not a converted spa hotel.

name: Komune Resort & Beach Club Keramas
who: Surf-and-fitness resort on Bali's best right-hand reef break; daily STOTT Pilates, a recovery centre, and 'Art of Longevity' programming alongside surf coaching.
why: Fused world-class surf access with structured daily training, drawing a global surf-fitness crowd.
takeaway: Book this for daily Pilates and recovery work alongside serious surf coaching — surf-fitness combo, not surf-only.

name: Alba Wellness Valley by Fusion
who: Hot-spring wellness valley outside Hue; multi-day programs pairing thermal-mineral therapy with daily fitness and yoga classes, from ~$250/night.
why: Vietnam's leading purpose-built wellness resort, repeatedly named the country's best upcountry property.
takeaway: Book this for thermal-mineral therapy paired with daily fitness and yoga — a purpose-built wellness valley.

name: Absolute Sanctuary
who: Boutique wellness and longevity resort with a strong yoga-teacher-training and detox program calendar; 3-14 night stays.
why: A long-standing Koh Samui yoga and detox specialist with an international teacher-training reputation.
takeaway: Book a yoga-teacher-training or detox program here — a specialist yoga stay, not a general beach resort.

name: Amatara Welleisure Resort
who: Cliffside 'welleisure' resort coining its own wellness-plus-leisure category; daily yoga, Muay Thai, and fitness classes alongside spa and detox menus.
why: Regularly shortlisted at the Conde Nast Johansens Awards; a well-known mid-tier Phuket wellness address.
takeaway: Book this for a mix of daily Muay Thai, yoga and spa detox — wellness-plus-leisure, not pure training.

name: Eden Health Retreat
who: Rainforest health retreat on almost 400 acres in the Gold Coast hinterland; 3-14 night stays of daily fitness sessions, hikes, and health coaching.
why: Billed as Australia's longest-running health retreat, with a large and loyal repeat-guest base.
takeaway: Book 3 to 14 nights of daily fitness, hikes and health coaching in the rainforest — structured, not scenery alone.

name: Naad Wellness
who: New-generation luxury Ayurveda and naturopathy retreat near Delhi; personalized multi-week healing programs including yoga, naturopathy, and fitness therapy.
why: One of India's fastest-rising high-end wellness addresses, positioned to compete with Ananda and Six Senses Vana.
takeaway: Book a personalized multi-week Ayurveda and naturopathy programme here — India's newest high-end healing address.

name: Amanoi
who: Aman resort inside Nui Chua National Park; wellness immersions blend personal training, Pilates, and yoga with spa and hydrotherapy, from ~$1,300/night.
why: Vietnam's answer to Amanpuri: an ultra-luxury Aman property with a genuinely structured wellness program rather than a spa menu alone.
takeaway: Book a structured Pilates, yoga and personal-training immersion here — genuine wellness programming, not just a scenic Aman stay.

name: PhuketFit
who: All-inclusive weight-loss and fitness bootcamp near Ya Nui Beach; 1-4 week programs of daily group training and calorie-controlled meals, from ~$150/night.
why: A budget-tier fixture of Phuket's fitness-camp scene, self-marketed as Thailand's #1 health and fitness retreat.
takeaway: Book this for budget-tier group training and calorie-controlled meals near the beach — cheap and cheerful, not premium.
